component.name: Arcadex
component.summary: Your ROM library, with artwork, ready to play

description.p: Point Arcadex at the folders where you keep your ROMs. It identifies each one by its contents, fetches box art and details, and launches it in RetroArch or a standalone emulator. Play time is recorded per game.

ul.li: Six layouts, from a dense desktop grid to couch layouts made for a controller
Saves and play time kept the same across machines, through a folder you already sync
Disc images, multi-disc games and console game folders recognised as the games they are
ROM hacks, cheats and dump verification against No-Intro and Redump catalogues

description.p: Arcadex works with games you already have. It does not search for or download games, BIOS files, firmware or keys.
Playdex is now Arcadex. Saves and play time sync between machines, and this Flatpak runs on the Steam Deck, opening full screen in a couch layout from Game Mode.
